manifest_metadata.project: Climate Risk, Value, and Investing — Exam Capstone

sources.name: Copernicus Climate Data Store — ERA5 Reanalysis & Thermal Heat Indices
sources.units: Degrees Celsius, Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Wet-Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT)
sources.geography: Southeast Asian Urban Corridors (Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, Manila, Jakarta)
sources.coverage: 1991-2025 daily reanalysis + IPCC AR6 extreme heat projections to 2040

sources.name: NGFS Phase IV Climate Scenarios Database
sources.units: USD/tCO2 (Carbon price trajectories), Primary energy mix %, Regional GDP shock %
sources.geography: Asia-Pacific Regional Aggregates & Southeast Asia Models
sources.coverage: 2025-2050 trajectories: Current Policies, Net Zero 2050, and Delayed Transition

sources.name: ASEAN Exchange Corporate Filings & Sustainability Reports
sources.geography: Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia)
sources.coverage: 10 listed entities (SEMB, TNB, MER, GULF, PGAS, CPALL, WILM, THBEV, URC, INDF) FY2023-FY2025

sources.name: Our World in Data & GHG Protocol Cross-Sectoral Emission Tools
sources.geography: ASEAN member states (SG, MY, TH, PH, ID)
sources.coverage: National grid emission factors and sector intensity averages 2000-2024

sources.name: ICMA & ASEAN Capital Markets Forum (ACMF) Labelled Bond Standards
sources.units: BPS (Coupon step-up penalties), KPIs, Second-Party Opinions
sources.geography: ASEAN Sustainability-Linked Bond Standards (ASEAN SLBS) & Green Bond Guidelines
sources.coverage: Framework benchmarks, MAS Sustainable Bond Grant Scheme provisions, KPI criteria
